title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: NEW Airports & Scenery You MUST See! ✈️🌍 (Week of Jan 19, 2026)
description:
🔍 Description
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace update brings a massive wave of new airports and stunning scenery enhancements — and in this video, I’ll walk you through every new addition worth your attention! ✈️✨

We’ll explore all newly released airports and scenery packs that landed on the PC marketplace this week, including fresh lighting upgrades, iconic international hubs, and beautifully crafted regional airfields. Whether you love bush flying, international routes, or night‑lighting immersion, there’s something here for every simmer.
